# ethereum-optimism/op-geth Daily Update (Jan 19, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's focus was on merging upstream go-ethereum updates, with versions v1.16.6, v1.16.7, and v1.16.8 integrated, alongside a critical bug fix for a flaky interop test.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Upstream Go-Ethereum Merges
Multiple go-ethereum versions (v1.16.6, v1.16.7, and v1.16.8) were merged into op-geth, bringing a wide range of updates and improvements across various components including `cmd/devp2p`, `core/rawdb`, and `eth/fetcher`. ([#727](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/727), [#728](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/728), [#751](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/751))

### Flaky Test Fixes
A flaky `TestInteropTxRejectedWithFailsafe` test in the miner component was identified and fixed, improving the reliability of the test suite. ([#752](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/752))

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#753](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/pull/753) miner: fix flaky TestDAFilters test: This PR aims to address another flaky test related to DA filters in the miner.

## CLOSED ISSUES
No issues were closed today.

## NEW ISSUES
No new issues were reported today.

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### op-reth: batcher throttling ([#18764](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18764))
Discussion continues on the implementation of batcher throttling in `op-reth`. The latest comment notes that both throttle mechanisms appear to be implemented in the `op-reth` payload builder, but no related testing has been found yet.

### op-supernode: Reset Handling ([#18740](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18740))
The discussion revolves around how `op-supernode` handles resets, particularly in the context of `op-wheel` and `op-node`. The latest comment highlights confusion regarding how `forkChoiceUpdate` (FCU) was previously working, as experience and source code tests suggest FCU doesn't move the unsafe head back to a canonical block on `op-geth`. Prior art using `debug_setHead` and `forkChoiceUpdate` in `op-wheel` and `op-node`'s reliance on FCU triggered by `op-supervisor` are mentioned.

### chore(sysgo/p2p): fix op-reth <-> op-geth connection flakiness ([#18570](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/op-geth/issues/18570))
This issue concerns flaky P2P connections between `op-reth` and `op-geth` in system tests. A new pull request has been made to address this issue, and the community is encouraged to review it. The problem is considered a major bug due to its impact on test stability and potential production compatibility. The need to assign someone to investigate the P2P implementation differences between `op-reth` and `op-geth` and verify `admin_peers` encoding is emphasized.
